pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Brave Origin is a minimalist build of the Brave browser. It keeps Brave Shields — the ad blocking, tracker blocking, and privacy protections — and the underlying Chromium engine, but drops the additional products bundled with the regular browser: Leo, News, Playlist, Rewards (and Brave Ads), Speedreader, Talk, Tor, VPN, Wallet (and Web3 domains), Wayback Machine, Web Discovery Project, and email aliases. It also omits the daily usage ping, crash reporting, and the P3A privacy-preserving analytics.
Origin is free on Linux. It stores its profile under ~/.config/BraveSoftware/Brave-Origin, so it can be installed alongside www-client/brave-browser without sharing data.
